Class KeyboardDevice

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a keyboard input device, providing access to keyboard buttons, state tracking, character input, and utility methods for keyboard input.

public sealed class KeyboardDevice : InputDevice, IComparable<InputDevice>

DeviceProcessPriority

The process priority of this keyboard device instance.

Change this value to change the order in which this device is processed in InputSystem. Lower priorities are processed first. 

public uint DeviceProcessPriority

Field Value

uint

Remarks

A unique value based on the order of instantiation is assigned per default.

GetValue(ShapeKeyboardButton, ModifierKeySet?)

Gets the value of the specified keyboard button, considering the optional modifier key set. Returns 1.0f if the button is down and modifiers (if any) are active; otherwise, returns 0.0f.

public float GetValue(ShapeKeyboardButton button, ModifierKeySet? modifierKeySet = null)

button ShapeKeyboardButton

The keyboard button to check.

modifierKeySet ModifierKeySet

Optional modifier key set that must be active.

Returns

float

1.0f if the button is down and modifiers are active; otherwise, 0.0f.

GetValue(ShapeKeyboardButton, ShapeKeyboardButton, ModifierKeySet?)

Gets the axis value based on two keyboard buttons (negative and positive), considering the optional modifier key set. Returns 1.0f if the positive button is down, -1.0f if the negative button is down, or 0.0f if neither or both are down.
